mkha' nang nas phyir spros nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad yongs su gang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sna tshogs pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byas/ sems can thams cad la byang chub kyi 'od zer gyis dbang bskur/ sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ de rnams dang sngon nas grub pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sprul pa'i lha tshogs rnams dang gcig tu 'dres/ thams cad slar 'dus/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la thim par gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya ste/ gtso bo drug gi snying po brgya rtsa re/ rtsa sngags nye snying sogs tshar re/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags gsum gsum bzla ba'i lag len yod do// gsum pa mchod cing bstod pa ni/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs nas bstod pa'i bar ni gong lha sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin bya'o// der ma zad mchod (176)pa 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad/ sngags dang phyag rgya ji tsam shes pa de thams cad kyis 'tshams par mchod de mchod pa'i khyad par rgyas pa nyid mchog go /bzhi pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ de nas gtor ma rnams byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul tshul sgrub thabs bzhin te/ cung zad khyad par yod pa sta gon gyi skabs bzhin no// gtor ma gnyis pa myur mdzad ye shes mgon po la gtor chog ltar 'bul/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro sde lnga 'bul te/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badzra ā kaṭṭe ā kaṭṭe/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ bandha ya bandha ya/ sarba badzra ḍā ki nī naṃ hrī da yaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces lan gsum gyis spyan drangs/ oṃ buddha ḍā ki nī pri tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ oṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ḍā kī nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ratna ḍā kī nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ trām̐ phaṭa/ oṃ padma ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hrīḥphaṭa/

oṃ karma ḍā nī pra titstsha i maṃ ba liṃ āḥphaṭa/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hoḥphaṭa/ zhes lan lngas phul/ ārghaṃ nas shabda 'i bar dang 'bru gsum gyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar 'don pa spos pas bstod/ gtor ma tha ma 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma yang sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin no// 'on kyang 'dir gshegs gsol mi bya// phyogs skyong dang nag po chen po dur khrod dang*/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga khyams la bzhugs par bsam/ phyi rol gtor ma ni/ mdor bsdus pa'i tshe/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang*/ 'bring la mos pa'i tshe dgyes mdzad rdo rje nas 'byung ba'i 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma dang*/ rgyas pa la mos pa'i tshe/ phyogs bzhi dang*/ steng ste lngar gtor ma che ba re mchod pa dang bcas pa re 'bul dgos la/ thams cad la'ang mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ gtor ma byin rlabs rnams gong sa chog gi skabs dang 'dra/ shar du phyogs skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba yang gong sa chog gi skabs bzhin/ lho ru/ phaiṃ badzra ā ralli hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dṛ shya ho/ /zhes 'byung po thams cad spyan drangs/ (177)oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa bhu tā pre ta pi shā tsa/ unmā da/ a pa smā ra/ ṭā ka ṭā ki n+yā da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛ hṇāntu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ ma ma sarba siddhimme pra yatstshantu/ ya thai ba/ ya thaiṣṭaṃ bhuñdza tha/ pi pa tha/ dzi ghra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā rā ta ya/ sat+su khaṃ bi shuddha/ sa hā yi kā bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ /zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ nub tu mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i gtor ma sngar bshad pa ltar 'bul/ byang du rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis/ phyogs skyong ba bcu srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ bhu dza ra ṇāṃ/ ya pa tā la tsa rā ṇāṃ/ man khe tsa rā ṇāṃ/ ta pūrba a dhi ga tā nāṃ/ ka dakṣi ṇa a dhi ga tā nāṃ/

hūm̐ pashtsa ma a dhi ga tā nāṃ/ phaṭa utta ra ṇa a dhi ga tā nāṃ/ oṃ i hrīḥya bi kṣo tṛ ta i na ā na de hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba bhu te bhyo ha ha ha hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ so so'i mthar arghaṃ la sogs pas phyi mchod dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod dang*/ dam tshig ldan zhing 'jig rten skyong*// srid pa gsum na gang gnas pa// 'gro ba'i don kun spyod pa la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab pa rnams thams cad la sbyor/ steng phyogs su sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar spyi gtor rgyas par 'bul ba las/ thams cad rang mdog thig ler zhu/ zhes pa nas/ g.yas brkyang bzhugs shing dur khrod brgyan/ /ces pa'i bar dor/ gtso bo lnga'i rtsa sngags dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags drag tu bzlas/ yungs kar gtor zhing bgegs bskrad la mtshams bcad/ slar nang du 'ong ma thag las bum gyi chus khrus byas la kha bshal/ dkyil 'khor la lan gsum du bskor ba byas te/ oṃ badzra utgā ṭa ya sa ma (178)pra be sha ya hūm̐ zhes hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dral bas phyogs bzhi'i sgo dbye/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan// sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud// dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥrab tu grub par mdzod// mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol/ /ho zhes me tog phul/ sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐ zhes pas mgo bor me tog bcings la/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /ces gsol ba drag tu btab/ bdun pa ni/ 'og nas ji ltar 'byung ba'i slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i cho ga nyid chog gi kha bsgyur phran bu'i 'dor len phyed par byas la bdag 'jug rdzogs par blang ngo*// brgyad pa ni/ thog mar dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du maṇḍal phul la//

dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /zhes lan gsum/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon khyod la skyabs su mchi// gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi// lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// rgyal ba mi gnas mya ngan 'das// bcom ldan khyod sku bdag la ston/ /ces lan gsum/ gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir ru ni// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya/ /lan gsum/ oṃ na ma ste hūm̐/ na maḥme hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ phyogs bzhi nas phyag bya/ bdun rnam dag bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod gang la dga'// skal ba bzang la bdag dga'o// skal bzang des khyod ci zhig byed// sangs rgyas mchog 'dod dam tshig yin/ oṃ tsakṣu bandha wa rā ma na ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje (179)dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi/ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ/ badzra yo ga bo dhi tsitta ya thā su khaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'am/ āḥkhaṃ wi ra hūm̐ zhes pas yol ba'i nang du bcug par bsam/ lha'i dam tshig bsgrags pa ni rdo rje mgo bor bzhag la/ /'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste// khyod kyis spyi bor bzhag pa yis// sangs rgyas sku ru khyod 'grub cing*// mi phyed ye shes mchog tu 'gyur/ /yang snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ /he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /mna' chu blud pa ni/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/

oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta yu da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ slob dpon gyis dam tshig bsgrags pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ /deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyi// he ru ka dpal nga yin gyi// nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa// gus pa'i tshul gyis nyan par byon// gal te nga la brnyas pa na// sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas pas na// mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas// sems can dmyal bar gyur ta re/ /ye shes dbab pa'i don du maṇḍal phul la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// byin gyis brlabs pa'i ye shes de// rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la deng*// slob dpon khyod kyis dbab tu gsol/ /lan gsum/ dang po'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya snying gar gtad la/ /'di ni ye shes rdo rje ste// rdo rje sems dpa' yin par bsgrags// rdo rje ye shes bla med ni// de ring nyid du dbab par shog /slob mas lha la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ bdag la dpal he ru ka dbab du gsol/ (180) lan gsum/ khyed rang 'od dpag med dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i rkang mthil du/ dzāeṃ ljang nag rlung gi rang bzhin/ lte bar raṃ dmar po me drag tu 'bar ba/ snying gar hūm̐ yig sngon po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba sa khams kyi rang bzhin/ spyi bor pam̐ las bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po dbus su maṃ yig dang*/ 'og tu haṃ yig dkar po mgo mthur du bstan pas mtshan pa/ skabs 'dir spro na/ 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge rnams kyis mtshon par bsgom pa dang*/ shin tu bsdu na/ spyi bor yang yi ge gsum kho nas chog par bzhed do/ /dzhaiṃ las 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros/ byin pa nas brgyud/ brla'i rtsa bo che nas zhugs/ sum mdor gcig tu 'dres/ lte ba'i raṃ las phog pas/ me lce drag tu 'bar te/ snying ga'i hūm̐ bsregs/

spyi bo'i haṃ la phog pas/ bdud rtsi'i bde ba chen po'i rgyun skya chil chil babs pas/ snying ga dang lte ba'i yi ge la phog cing*/ lus thams cad du khyab pas/ gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba dbyings su nub cing*/ bde stong gi ye shes lhang gi skyes// slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma khro bo dang khro mo thams cad ba spu'i bu ga nas sib sib thim par gyur/ oṃ ā be sha ya ā be sha ya/ stambha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya tsa la ya/ ha le ya/ hūm̐ ya haṃ hūm̐ dzhaiṃ swā hā/ zhes drag tu bzla/ gu gul dang*/ tshil chen byi la nag po'i thun/ zla mtshan gyis bgos pa'i ras rnams ro sol gyi me la bsregs pa'i dud pas bdug /rol mo sna tshogs bya/ a khaṃ/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// (181)lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*// dngos grub bsod nams de bzhin shog /ces bden pa'i stobs brjod do/ /sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i yi dam lha// gang yin de ring bdag gi ni// rigs dang mthun pa'i dngos grub dang*// lha dang ma nor mjal bar shog /oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ

zhes pas me tog dor/ sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pa'i// me tog rnam par snang mdzad 'di// stobs chen khyod kyis rab bcings pas// rigs kyi bdag por dbang bskur ro// oṃ pra tītstsha gṛhṇa st+waṃ/ sa ma ya māṃ swā hā/ rdo rjes mig dbye ste/ /he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// phye bas thams cad mthong bar shog /oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra phaṭa laṃ hrīḥ.āḥ badzra tsakṣuḥpra be sha ya hūm̐ zhes brjod/ he badzra pa shya hrīḥ zhes pas gdong g.yogs bkrol nas/ lha ngo bstan pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// mthong nas dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin rlabs kyis// 'gro don phun sum tshogs kun dang*// dngos grub thams cad mngon du 'gyur// dam tshig thams cad srung ba dang*// gsang sngags la yang brtson par bgyi/ /ces brjod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi nam mkha' la brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad/ dur khrod rnams su chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang bcas pa thams cad bzhugs par mos/ dgu pa ni/ sbyang ba gnyis ni sngon 'gro yin// chu cod rdor dril ming dang lnga// dngos gzhi nyid de chu dbang la// bsang sbyang lhar bskyed byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes dbang lha spyan 'dren mchod// dbang bskur bzlas pa mchod bstod bya// gsol btab shis brjod chu dbang bskur// slar yang mchod bstod dag pa brjod// (182) dbang lha spyan 'dren ma gtogs pa// 'og ma rnams kyang phal cher 'dra// ces bya ste/ de yang rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bskur ba'i don du maṇḍal phul/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de bzhin bdag la'ang deng stsol cig /bdag gzhan ngan 'gro las sgrol zhing*// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// gnas nas 'gro ba sgrol byed pa'i// ye shes dbang mchog bdag la stsol/

/zhes lan gsum/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wān bidya rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rol mo drag tu bya'o/ /oṃ badzra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmi ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ sarba bing shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de nas chu dbang bskur ba ni/ bdag dang dbang rdzas gnyis ka a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swā bhā wa sa sbyang*/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum chu/ stong pa'i ngang las/ padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ thod pa'i phreng ba dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra (183)pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra ghāṇḍe hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis ka dang gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rigs pa'i lha mo khro bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ sogs nyer spyod lnga phul la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/

oṃ āḥbadzra dhṛkra hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes mang du bzlas la me tog la sogs pa mchod/ /mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ sogs shlo ka gcig gis bstod/ mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs te zhu ba las byung ba'i chur gyur/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gis lha dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gsol ba btab par mos te/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab// slob dpon gyis so so'i bum pa mang du yod na/ rang sngags kyi bum pa so so'i bum chu bum pa'am/ ka pā lar bsdus/ rnam rgyal bum pa gcig kho na yin na/ de nyid thogs te/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas padma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// (184)'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o// de yi nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye rgu rnams la zhi byed pa// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o// dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o// bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus bskyed byed bde ba chen po ste// de yis deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs sogs bya/

/ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ las bum gyis khrus bya// de nas rnam rgyal bum pa thogs la/ /kun gzhi rnam shes rnam dag cing*// me long ye shes ngo bo nyid// bcom ldan mi bskyod pa yis ni// ye shes chu rgyun dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba thā ga ta badzra a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐// dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /gtso bo rnams kyis snying po brjod la/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes re re la btags/ thams cad mjug tu/ brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ dbang bskur sku gang dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma yar (185)lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ nam mkha'i dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams las/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung nas/ rang nyid la thim/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ sogs nyer spyod lnga dang rol mo 'bul/ /mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ sogs slob ma la bstod pa bya/ de ltar khyod la chu'i dbang bskur bas// rnam par shes pa'i phung po rgyal ba mi bskyod pa dang*// chu'i khams mā ma ki'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing*// zhe sdang ma spangs bar dag nas// me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du gyur/ /'di man chad la 'don pa bsgyur bar bya'o// cod pan gyi dbang ni/ bsang sbyang*/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan/ stong pa'i ngang las/ padma nyi ma'i gdan la/

āṃ las rin po che āṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ thod pa'i phreng ba dang*// rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ/ thugs kar hūm̐/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gyi rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'i bar gong bzhin/ gnyis ka dang gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas// (186)oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ āḥratna dhṛkra hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ /zhes mang du bzlas la me tog la sogs pas mchod/ rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// mi rtog nam mkha' dri ma med// dngos 'dzin dag pas gos pa med// rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ zhes sogs shlo ka gcig gis bstod/ rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs te zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i cod pan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol// thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan cing*// sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsngags pa'i// rin chen 'bar ba'i dbu rgyan dang*// dar dbyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ratna a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di gtso bo rnams kyi snying po'i mthar btags la mthar

oṃ badzra ratna a bhi ṣe ka ta hūm̐ su ra ta st+waṃ a haṃ/ oṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra tu ṣya ho/ zhes bcings te cod pan gyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba nas/ shrī ye hūm̐ gi bar gyi chu dbang bskur/ dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rna ltag g.yas su rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams las/ rin po che'i rigs kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung nas slob ma la thim/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs dang*/ rin chen rgyal po sogs kyis bstod/ de ltar khyed la cod pan gyis dbang bskur bas/ tshor ba'i phung po rgyal ba rin chen 'byung ldan dang nam mkha'i khams rin chen sgrol ma'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing*/ (187)nga rgyal dang ser sna ma spangs rang sar dag nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du gyur snyam du sgoms shig ces brjod/ rdo rje'i dbang ni/ bsang sbyangs la/ slob ma dang*/ dbang rdzas rdo rje stong pa'i ngang las padma nyi ma'i gdan la dzriṃ las padma dzriṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas padma dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ thod pa'i phreng ba dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'od dpag med yab yum gyi rnam par badzra sa ma dzaḥ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pa sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis ka dang gnyis su med par thim// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/

oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ āḥ.a ro la ka hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ puṣpe sogs/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// padma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs te zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i rdo rje du gyur/ (188)de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol// sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir// rdo rje'i dbang ni sbyin par bya// oṃ gtso bo rnams kyi snying po'i mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta padma a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ tiṣṭha bi ra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā sogs shrī ye hūm̐/ bar ces pas gtad/ dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ ltag par 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams las/ padma'i rigs kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med par byung nas slob ma rnams la thim/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che// mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// padma mkha' 'gro= de ltar khyed la rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas 'du shes kyi phung po rgyal ba 'od dpag med dang*/ me'i khams gos dkar mo'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing*/ 'dod chags ma spangs rang sar dag nas/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur snyams du sgoms shig /dril bu'i dbang ni/ bsang sbyangs/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas dril bu stong pa'i ngang las padma nyi ma'i gdan la khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas ral gri dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ thod pa'i phreng ba dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ yum dam tshig (189)sgrol ma ljang gu gri gug dang*/ thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ/ thugs kar hūm̐/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad don yod grub pa yab yum gyi rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bar/ gong bzhin gnyis ka dang gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzri bha wā bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang rdzas la dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ āḥpra dzñā dhṛkra hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ puṣpe sogs/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// sangs rgyas ngo bor nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gro= don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs te zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i dril bu gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu dbang*/ de ring khyod la= sangs rgyas kun tu= dril bu'i dbang ni=

snying po'i mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta karma a bhi ṣe ka sogs/ oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ zhes pas btad/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ghaṇḍe a dhiṣṭha na a bhi ṣe ka ta sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs/ dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rna ltag g.yon par don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad gang bas sangs rgyas rnams las las kyi rigs kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med par byung nas slob ma la thim/ (190)oṃ badzra paṣpe sogs/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gro= de ltar khyed la dril bu'i dbang bskur ba'i 'du byed kyi phung po rgyal ba don yod grub pa dang*/ rlung gi khams dam tshig sgrol ma'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing*// phrag dog ma spangs rang sar dag nas/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon tu gyur snyam du sgoms shig /ming gi dbang ni/ bsangs sbyang*/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas rdo rje dang*/ dril bu stong pa'i ngang las padma nyi ma'i gdan la bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo bhrūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las// gnyis ka'ang rnam snang dkar po g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ thod pa'i phreng ba dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gi brgyan pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ slob dpon gyi thugs dkar nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rnam snang yab yum gyi rnam par badzra sa ma dzaḥ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ sogs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bar gong bzhin/ gnyis ka dang gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang rdzas la dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu brgyan/ oṃ āḥdzi na dzi kra hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ puṣpe sogs/ rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro= rnam par snang mdzad yab yum snyoms par zhugs te zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje dang*/ dril bur gyur/ (191)de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang*/ de ring khyod la= sangs rgyas kun tu= /mi gi dbang mchog bskur bar bya/ snying po'i mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bu dha a bhi ṣe ka= zhes bsgrags la/ oṃ badzra sa twa st+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ badzra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta he shrī/ yang brtan byed du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas shri ye hūm̐/ gi cod pan gyi skabs bzhin/ dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las dpral bar rnam snang gi dbu brgyan/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams las de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung nas slob ma la thim/ oṃ badzra paṣpe sogs/ rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ rdo rje zhi ba= /rang bzhin gyis ni= /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro= /de ltar ming gis dbang bskur ba'i gzugs kyi phung po rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad/ sa'i khams sangs rgyas spyan ma'i ngo bor sangs rgyas shing*/ gti mug ma spangs rang sar dag nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du gyur snyam du sgoms shig /slar yang slob dpon gyis/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rgyud sde lnga yi dkyil 'khor du// de ring slob dpon ming dbang sbyin// dkyil 'khor gtso byed ming dbang 'grub/ oṃ āḥbadzra hūm̐/ bcu pa la/ gsol gdab phyag mtshan rdor dril sbyin/

dam tshigs gsum dang chu dbang mchod/ rjes gnang lung bstan dbugs dbyung zhing*/ brtul zhugs dag pa brjod pa'o// de la dang po ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ /'khor lo phyir mi bzlog pa'i dbang*// dam pa bdag la stsal nas kyang*// mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gis// de nyid slob dpon phrin las gsung*// de ring bdag (192)ni khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don nus 'gyur phyir// rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur bar// thugs rje can khyod stsal du gsol// rtag tu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// sems can bzung phyir rjes gnang sogs// bdag la de ring bka' drin mnos// mgon po thugs rjes thugs dam dgongs/ /zhes lan gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ dbang stegs legs par bsham thub na rab/ ma thub na yid kyis bsam pas chog ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri la khyed rang rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che dang*/ rus pa la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ rang snang gi shes rab dam pas 'khyud pa'i sku can du gyur/ steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ mtha' bskor du mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung pos yongs su bskor bar gyur/ hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i phyag mtshan rnams su gyur// he ru ka ni kha ṭwāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma ru// rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rdo rjer bcas// dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing*// tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /gri gug dang ni ka pā la// dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ /zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/ rdor dril gnyis ka bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/

rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur/ dpral ba oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs te thim/ de nyid zhu (193)ba las byung ba'i rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis// de nyid ngas par bstan mi bya// rdo rje dril bu mi spang ste// slob dpon rnams ni smad mi bya// sngags dang sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// mtshungs par mchod de 'bad pas gyis/ /zhes brjod/ /rang snang gi shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pas bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur/ bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje'i dbang ni sbyin par bya/ /snying gar gtod/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan dpal mchog dang po yi// skyes bu mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro// oṃ āḥm hā badzra hūm̐/ khyod kyis sems 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi don rtogs par bya'o// 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /dril bu lan brgyad dkrol/ /a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur// oṃ badzra ghāṇḍe a/ oṃ āḥs twa st+waṃ/ sgra thams cad grags stong du shes par gyis shig /rdo rje dang dril bu gnyis ka zung du sbyar la/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// bdag med yum mchog

(194)khyod la sbyin// rdo rje sku yi dngos grub thob// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ// yid kyi lus su bsten pa'i phyir// phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod// gang gi lus ni thams cad bsten// des na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags// gzugs su snang ba rnams lha skur shes par gyis shig /lnga pa ni/ oṃ phun sum nas/ bkra shis gsum pa'o// dbang bskur rdo rje nas/ shrī ye hūm̐ gi sa bar chu dbang bzhin/ de ltar dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dbang rtag su rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog gtor zhing brtan bzhugs bya/ drug pa ni/ bdag 'jug gi skabs su 'dir ārghaṃ nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod de tshigs bcad rnams mi dgos/ dbang gi lugs 'dir slob ma la mchod pa 'bul ba yin te/ /sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang*// sangs rgyas kun mchod rnal 'byor ma// de ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ phreng ba de yis rgyan yin no/ oṃ badzra kā ru ṇi kā lakṣa hūm̐ baṃ st+waṃ// rdo rje'i gdan 'di rdzogs sangs rgyas// sras dang bcas par rnam rol zhing*// rdo rje sgeg mo'i rab sbyor gyis// dga' ston bde ba'i mchod pa gyis// oṃ badzra ārghaṃ āḥhūm̐// sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor// byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa// mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi// bde gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur// bhrūm̐// rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas// brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis// lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su// ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis// gha// rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas// tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*// rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi// byang chub lus can rnams la bgos// hrīḥ(195)chos kyi me ni legs 'bar bas// padma gar dbang rang nyid des// sems can ma rig ldongs rnams la// chos kyi sgron me sbar bar gyis// gī// lus can kun la dam chos kyi// glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya// de ni rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*// myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur// oṃ// deng nas brtsams te byang chub bar// rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs kun// shes rab thabs kyi sbyor ba yis// bde ba'i gar gyis rol par gyis// hoḥ

/de nyid thal mo'i gar gyi ni// sangs rgyas thams cad chags par bya// sangs rgyas 'dul ba'i phrin las kyis// gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar bya/ /bdun pa ni// mig thur me long dril bu dang*// mda' gzhu 'khor lo dung po ti// sbrul bshad dngos grub mchod pa dang*// lha bsgom sngags kyi rjes gnang ngo*// de dag kyang rim pas/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib gsal ba ltar// rgyal ba rnams kyis bu khyod kyi// mi shes pa yi rab rib gsal// oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥtrāṃ/ zhes mig thur dang*/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dwangs la rnyogs pa med// bzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med par// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skyes/ /zhes brjod de me long dang*/ /a las byung ba'i dril bu// thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas// thams cad mchog gi gnyis med gsal/ /zhes dril bu dang*/ ho las byung ba'i mda' gzhu// de bzhin (196)gshegs pa thams cad dang*// rjes su chags par byos shig /ces mda' gzhu dang*/ oṃ badzra he tu māṃ/ rkang pa gnyis kyi bar du 'khor lo bzhag /deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa// brtsams te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// de ring phan chad sems can la// skyob pa rnams kyis 'khor lo bskor/ /zhes 'khor lo dang*/ oṃ badzra bhā ṣa raṃ/ lag pa g.yas su dung*/ /khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i tshul gyis su// chos kyi dung ni bla med pa// dri med kun tu gang bar gyis// oṃ ma hā dharma hūm̐/ rgyud kyi po ti/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di// skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan thogs drin du bzo zhes bya// rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang*// khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/

/zhes po ti dang*/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rim par gtad la/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i gnas su/ rdo rje dang*/ rin chen dang*/ padma dang*/ sna tshogs zhes pa rnams bcug la/ rigs lnga'i sprul pa'i sgo nas sems can rnams kyi dug lnga sbyangs te/ ye shes lnga rgyud la bskyed par gyis shig /ces rigs lnga'i rjes gnang dang*/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnon sogs dang*// bsad dang bskrad pa la sogs pa// las de rnams ni sgrub par gyis// ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*// mchil lh+wam de bzhin ril bu ste// rnal 'byor pa yis dngos grub ni// de ni ci dgar sgrag par gyis/ /zhes las dang dngos grub kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams (197)cad dang*// rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyis dngos// de las 'bad pa thams cad kyis// he ru ka dpal bdag mchod do/ /mchod pa'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi// khams gsum na ni sdig med de// de la 'dod la chags bral bar// khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /lha'i sku la sems yongs su chags cing*// zhen par gyis shig /lha bsgom pa'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /rigs lnga 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ /rigs lnga bdag la stsal lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /sngags bzlas pa'i rjes gnang ngo*// brgyad pa ni/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i skur gyur pas bla na med pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par gyur// rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag nyid dang*// phyogs dus sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// khyod la rtag tu lung ston 'gyur// bdag cag sangs rgyas mgrin gcig tu// bde bar gshegs par lung ston to// oṃ 'di ltar ngas khyod lung bstan te// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu rnam dag pas// srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod 'das// oṃ shrī he ru ka nā maḥsarba ta thā ta siddhi sa ma ya st+waṃ bhur bhuḥwa swaḥ

dgu pa ni/ gsang chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bcug pa dang ni mthong bas kyang*// sdig pa kun las rnam grol nas// de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas// bde chen (198)theg pa 'di la ni// phyin chad 'chi ba yod ma yin// mi thub pa dang mi tshugs pa// cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis// srid pa shin tu rnam dag pas// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/

/bcu pa ni/ dbang rdzas rdo rje bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur// de nyid spyi bo dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying ga rnams su reg la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// rdo rje sems dpa' phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcad// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa st+waṃ dhā ra yā mi badzra sa twa hi hi hi hī hūm̐/ deng phyin chad tha mal gyi spyod pa thams cad brtul nas sngags kyi spyod pa la zhugs par gyis shig /rang gi bdag nyid yongs spangs nas// dka' thub kyis kyang mi gdung zhing*// ci bde bar ni bde ba bzung*// 'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes brjod la don bshad/ bcu gcig pa ni/ /sems can don phyir sems bskyed pas// sems can bsgral ba'i don de la// gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid// chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyis phyir// gzhal med khang gru bzhi pa// dran pa nyer bzhag bzhis (199)shar sgo/ yang dag par spong ba bzhis lho sgo/ rdzu 'phrul gyis rkang pa bzhis nub sgo/ dbang po dang ni stobs byang sgo/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhis zur bzhi/ bsdu bzhi dngos po bzhis rta babs/ byang chub yan lag bdun gyis me tog gi phreng ba/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad kyis ka ba/ bdud bzhi yongs su bcom pas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ 'khor ba rnam par dag pas dur khrod/

rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir rdo rje'i thig dang ldan pa/ nyes pas ma gos pas padma/ ye shes chen pos nyi ma/ 'jigs tshogs la lta ba yongs su 'joms pas rdo rje// byang chub kyi sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams so// lha rnams ni phung po lnga dang*/ khams bzhi dang*/ dbang po drug dang*/ yul drug rnam par dag pa ye shes lnga dang*/ tshad med pa rnams dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa'i bdag nyid do// gzhan yang deng nas khyod kyis dbang bskur ba dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa la sogs pa slob dpon gyi las 'di dag mtha' dag sgrubs shig /de nas bum dbang gi dag pa brjod ni/ /de ltar na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs/ dam tshig tu rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba la dbang*/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pas/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pa yin no/ /zhes brjod/ de dag gis bum pa'i dbang 'khor dang bcas pa'o// bcu gcig pa ni/ dbang gong ma gsum thun mongs kyi don du maṇḍal phul/ (200)bdag ni 'khor bar bying ba yi// 'gro ba skyabs med phongs nas ni// de bsgral phyir ni khyod nyid dang*// rdo rje 'dzin bdag slob dpon la// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes mchog /gsang dbang bla na med pa zhu// brtse bas bdag la gnang bar mdzod// dam tshig ji bzhin bdag gis bgyid/ /lan gsum/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa mtshon cha can gyi skur gsal ba'i spyi bor dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor/ mgrin par ma hā mā yā lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ snying gar dgyes mdzad thod pa can lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/

lte bar 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor/ gsang bar rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum thod pa bzhi dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams skad cig gis grub par gyur// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ rig ma skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje bdag med mar gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ nas thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mas byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ dkyil 'khor lha lnga'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi zhal du zhugs/ gsang ba'i lam nas byung ba rnams gcig tu bsdus te/ gzhi lus kyi rtsa a wa dhū ti'i lam nas brgyud/ rdo rje dang padma'i lam nas byung ste/ ga pur dang si hla gcig tu 'dres pa'i rgyun ye shes bdud rtsi lnga gcig tu 'dres pa'i ka pā la ra babs par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ gsang dbang (201) kho na'i don du maṇḍal phul/ /oṃ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor cig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// bdag nyid chen po khyod ji bzhin// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// nyon mongs ye shes nyid gyur pas// byang chub sems chen bdag la stsol/ /lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ stong pa'i ngang las/ slob ma dgyes mdzad mtshon cha can zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ de ba pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ye shes pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis gdong bcings/ oṃ badzra yo ga tsitta u ta pā da yā mi/ ces sems bskyed/ bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag /ji ltar bcom ldan dgyes rdor gyis// byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar// bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni// sems kyi rgyan gyis dbang bskur ro/

/gtso bo lnga'i snying po'i mthar/ 'bru gsum btags pa brjod/ slob mas kyang a ho ma hā su khaṃ zhes bya/ de bzhin du shes rab rdo rje bdag med ma'i gzugs kyis kyang dbang bskur bar 'gyur// ji ltar bcom ldan bdag med mas// byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar// bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni// sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro// oṃ āṃḥswā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ de nas 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ ngag gi dri ma sbyangs/ dam tshig tu sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa bza' ba'i dam tshig rnams sgrub pa la dbang*/ (202)gtum mo dang sgyu lus yan lag dang bcas pa sgoms pas/ 'bras bu longs sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/ /shes rab ye shes kyi don du phyag dang maṇḍal phul/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams// gcig bsdus bde ba chen po ste// gsang ba'i ye shes bdag la stsol/ /lan gsum/ gong bzhin mig dgab/ de nas mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rig ma gtad// dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// bzung cig bzung cig sems dpa' che// bzung la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min// 'gro gsung 'di'ang dag pa yin// de phyir 'di dang bral bar ni// khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med// blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba// de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /lha mo des kyang*/ bdud rtsi bza' dang btung ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par bu spro'am// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i padmar 'o byed par// bu khyod ji ltar bde byed smros/

lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro// bdud rtsi lnga po bza' bar bya// bdag med ma la rtag tu gus// bha ga'i padmar 'o byed par// a ho nga yi padma ni// bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan// ci ste cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste// sangs rgyas bstan pa la sogs pa// bya ba padmar byed bzhin gyis// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// oṃ āḥbhañdza mokṣa haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas slob (203)ma dgyes mdzad rdo rje mtshon cha can zhal phyag thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ rig ma rdo rje bdag med mar gyur/ gnyis ka'i rtsa 'khor lo lnga rab tu gsal ba la rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ /sgrub thabs bzhin mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ slob ma dang*/ rig ma'i gnas lngar thim pas bde ba chen pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ rjes chags gtum mo rab tu 'bar bas spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu/ mgrin par phyin pas dga' ba/ snying gar phyin pas mchog dga'/ lte bar phyin pas khyad dga'/ nor bur phyin pas lhan cig skyes dga' mngon du byas/ slar yar hūm̐ zhes bya bas gyen du gshegs par gyur te/ 'khor lo bzhir rim pas mas brtan pa'i dga' ba shar te/ spyi bor lhan cig skyes pa brtan par gyur/ /'bru gsum gyi gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ yid kyi dri ma sbyangs// dam tshig tu dngos dang ye shes kyi rig ma bsten pa la dbang*/ lam las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang 'od gsal sgom pas/ 'bras bu chos sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel sgrigs pa yin no/ /bzhi pa chen po tshig dbang zhu bar maṇḍal phul/ /khyod zhabs padmo'i bka' drin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/

/de nas bzhi pa tshig tsam gyis sbyin pa ni/ /ye shes 'di ni ches phra (204)zhing*// rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs// rdul med mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do// de nas bzhi ba'i ye shes de// man ngag sngon du sbyin pa ni// phyag rgya bzhi don gcig nyid du// brgyud pa yod pas de la bstan// phyag rgya bzhi don rim pa lnga// lam lnga skad cig de la bsgom// khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya// rdzun gyi tshig kyang sma bar bya// ma byin par yang khyod kyis long*// pha rol bud med bsten par bya// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la rol// mi bza' ba ni gang yang med// rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi bsrung*// des ni tha mal spangs nas 'grub// de ltar na/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma'i bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ dam tshig tu dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang spyod pa la dbang*// lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po bsgom pas/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/ de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal 'bul ba dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs dang*/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams bya'o// bcu gnyis pa ni/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar tshigs bcad dang bcas pa gong bzhin brjod// de bzhin du nang mchod kyang sngar bzhin phul/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba dus pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dpal sgyu 'phrul chen po'i lha (205)tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dpal gshin rje gshed rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/

rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhing skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ dpal gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga la sogs pa phyi nang gsang ba'i dam can gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag dang sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi gnas la 'god par mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar ba dang*/ sems can thams cad la bde skyid 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par rig pa 'dzin pa'i theg pa lung dang rtog pas bsdus pa mtha' dag byin rlabs mi nyams shing shin tu dar bar mdzad du gsol// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la mchog dang thun mongs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa tshe 'di nyid la stsal du gsol/ rgyud kyi rgyal po rnams las ji skad bshad pa'i las thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub pa mdzad du gsol/ /zhes dngos grub zhu/ yi ge brgya pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs 'don zhing*/ /ma 'byor ba dang sogs dang*/ lhag pa dang ni sogs dang*/ gtso bos nus pa mchis pa sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i thad du gnas pas/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du mos pas/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// (206)slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /ces lan gsum gyis mthar rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ oṃ a kā mū khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā dya nutpanna twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa muḥ zhes brjod cing thog mar dbang ldan gyis brtsigs pa bshig /de rjes su thig chen brgyad kyis nas dbye'o// mthar ci bder phyags shing lha mtshan rnams logs su bsdu'o// de byin rlabs kyi don du rang gyi spyi bor cung zad blugs la/

don du gnyer ba rnams la'ang cung zad byin/ de nyid bum pa bzang por blug ste bkur sti dang bcas klu brgyad mchod pa'i chogs chu bor spyan drangs shing gtad do// slar 'ong ste thig rjes rnams mi mngon par byas la/ lha mo sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags kyis phur bu phyung zhing*/ sngags de nyid kyis phur khung kyang 'o mas bkang ngo*// sgrub mchod nyid zhag sbrel mar byed na yang gshegs gsol gyi nyin mo ma gtogs gshegs gsol gyi don du brtan bzhugs bya zhing*/ dngos gzhi nyin rting ma rnams la nam mkha'i lha 'phebs pa'i skor rnams mi dgos so// smon lam ni sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba'i/ /skye zhing skye bar rigs mchog tu/ zhes sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i bsngo smon rgyas par brjod/ bkra shis ni/ /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ zhes sogs zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa sngon tu 'gro bas me tog char du bsnyil zhing*/ bkra shis 'byung gnas rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtshor khyab pa'i bdag /yid bzhin nor ltar gsol btab 'dod don thogs pa med par stsal// byin rlabs char pas skal ldan zhing sar smin grol 'bras bu skyed// dpal ldan bla ma'i bkra shis snang bas khams gsum yongs grol shog /bkra shis gang zhig bde chen chos sku'i nam mkha' yangs pa la// 'od gsal longs sku nges pa lnga ldan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// gang 'dul sprul sku'i 'od zer dra bas 'gro blo'i pad tshal 'byed// sku bzhi dbyer med bkra shis dpal 'bar ma rig mun sel shog /(207)bkra shis gang zhig dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos dbyings pho brang du// rdo rje 'chang chen na dā'i sgras bstan rin chen rgya mtsho'i rgyud// phyag rgya sngags dang ye shes mthar thug ston pa rnam lnga'i lnga// ngo mtshar dkyil 'khor bkra shis dpal 'bar lnga phung dbyings grol shog /bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi 'byung gnas thar pa chen po'i grong*// byang chub phyogs chos bkod pas rab mdzes kun bzang mchod sprin 'khrigs// tshogs brgyad rnam dag dur khrod brgyad ldan rdo rje'i srung 'khor gtams// gzhal med khang chen bkra shis dpal 'bar dag pa rab 'byams shog

/bkra shis gang zhig rdo rje btsun mo'i bha gar legs bzhugs pa// dgyes pa'i rdo rje sku bzhi ye shes rnam pa lnga yi dngos// shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid e waṃ rang bzhin zung du 'jug /dkyil 'khor gtso mchog bkra shis dpal 'bar dngos grub gnyis thob shog /bkra shis gang zhig chos dbyings gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na// thams cad bdag nyid sgyu 'phrul drwa ba sna tshogs rol pa can// mi phyed rdo rje gsum bdag rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyi// gsang ba 'dus pa'i bkra shis dpal 'bar snang gsum rnam dag shog /bkra shis gang zhig snying rje'i mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che// dga' chen sngags kyi me tog phreng bas mkha' mnyam sku lus brgyan// gnyis snang sha chen rtogs med gsol mdzad dpal ldan thugs rje'i stobs// sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i bkra shis dpal 'bar nyon mongs 'ching gcod shog /bkra shis gang zhig 'khor 'das rtog pa'i drwa ba ji snyed pa// (208)lhan skyes 'od gsal phyag rgyas mi shigs bde ba chen por sdom// dkyil 'khor 'dren pa rnal 'byor ma dpal dpyid kyi bdud rtsis dgyes// 'khor lo sdom pa'i bkra shis dpal 'bar bde ba mchog brnyes shog /bkra shis gang zhig rgyal kun mthu stobs phrin las bsdus pa'i sku// dran pa tsam gyis bdud sde lha min dus kyi man pa kun// cig char 'joms pa'i nyin byed ye shes gzi brjid 'bum 'phro ba// 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i bkra shis dpal 'bar bdud bzhi las rgyal shog /bkra shis gang zhig nam mkha' dang mnyam snying po'i ye shes lnga// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las mtha' yas sgyu ma'i gar// dug lnga'i dpung 'joms dkyil 'khor rnam lnga rten dang brten par bcas// gdod nas yongs grub bkra shis dpal 'bar sku lnga lhun grub shog /bkra shis gang zhig sangs rgyas rdo rje rin chen padma las// ye shes rigs lnga'i sprin 'phro dngos grub gnyis kyi char rgyun 'bebs// gnas gsum dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs zhing sngags lhan cig skyes// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis dpal 'bar sgrub la mchog stsol shog

/bkra shis gang zhig snying rje rab khros myur mdzad nag po che// phyogs skyong ma mo 'byung po'i tshogs bcas dam tshig bka' yi gnyer// rtag tu zhi yang 'bar ba'i gzugs kyis rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong*// dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis dpal 'bar bsam don yongs 'grub shog /bkra shis gang zhig don dam bden pa 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// brtan g.yo kun khyab snying po'i rang bzhin lhun grub yon tan ldan// srid dang zhi ba'i dge legs kun 'byung (209)gzhom du med pa'i dbyings// rnam kun mchog ldan bkra shis dpal 'bar rtag brtan kun khyab shog// /

ces pa'am/ yang na/ yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyi ri bo bzhin/ zhes sogs bkra shis bka' rgya ma lta bu'i shis pa'i tshig rgya cher brjod la shul de nyid du sbyin sreg dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa dga' ston rgya cher bya'o// de ltar bshad pa'i dge 'dis kyang*// dpag yas sems can ma lus rnams// yan lag bdun ldan sku bzhi'i dngos// rdo rje 'chang chen thob par shog /dpal rgyud sde lnga'i bdag 'jug ngag 'don 'di yang nyer mkhor mthong nas tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/// /'di la jo nang spar ma nyid yig skyon shin tu che bas sa bcad gong 'og ma mthun pa sogs dpyod dka' bas/ bslab pa gsum gyi bdag nyid mdo bstan sprul pa'i sku rin po ches sgrub dkyil gnyis bstan pa'i sri zhu kho nar dgongs nas spar gyi phyi mor bsgrubs pa'i skabs su kha 'phangs rigs nag 'gros dang sa bcad sogs bcos bsgyur zhabs 'debs phran bu zhu ba po ni/ 7 karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho ste des kyang rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //dge legs 'phel/// /(210)
